lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular blobs are distributed posterior to the gills. A primary vertical column contains four main nodes, with flanking columns showing similar spatial periodicity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light on the upper surface to shadow on the lower surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, high-luminance white object is attached or positioned immediately ventral to the pectoral fin area, contrasting significantly with the surrounding skin tone.
other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical gill slits are visible on the anterior flank, providing a clear anatomical reference for the lateral patterning.
